full_page.content:
1926, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 30 Cont.
Febr. 20 Catholic 10 year-old wants to be Method't Minister Joseph Yesbec 10 or 11 Clinton Ont. living among protestants since death of parents is insistant on being a protestant and a Method ... Pastor or relatives can do nothing to change him. Enrolled To-day by anxious sister in S.M.A.
Feb. 26th Wm Fulsher a Convert (not practically so yet) 30 yrs. Old a car- penter living in Wyandotte Enrolled as against falling; was working on the Michigan Alcolie Building almost finished at the time was prying with a crow-bar which slipped. A fall was threa- tened of about 200 feet with nothing to grab. Without knowing how it came a fence appeared behind him and to his astonishment and everyone watching the work, he took hold of that fence and was saved entirely. His wife heard first about it from non-Catholic boarders in a neighboring hotel. She is ever since a zealous promoter.
Mrs. Margaret Healey 67, Bad Axe Mich. wishes thanksgivings for re- storation from hopeless Erysiopolis.
St. Patricks Day: Tuberculosis of 4 yrs, Cured. Miss Margaret Connolly after doctoring four years for consumption considers it a positive wonder that she is abele to come from Windsor.
March 26" -Inward Cancer Charles Leo O'Connor 38 of 7449 Marcus Ave. having a wife and 3 small children operated repeatedly for cancer of stom- ach all to no avail, is Enrolled 4th time To-day before going to see Dr. C.K. - a Specialis
27 Curviture of Spine Cured. N.B. Mrs. Marg Rabedeau 44 of Gross Isle (1646 W. Gr Boulivard) enrolled last Wednsd'y for curiviture of spine after doctoring for years. On Friday yesterday her spine snapped back into place and she is here in perfect health To-day Thanks be to God!
Sept. 3rd Same Mrs. Rabedeau, still in perfect health enrolls way- word Brother To-day
July 10th 1927 Same Mrs. Rabedeau visited Monastery To-day with Husband and 11 year-old-boy to dedicate their 2nd child a little daughter born May 24 - 14 months after Ist Enrollment.
Mar 27 1935 died this a.m. at 3 0'cl.
